title: CodeReviewReport
description: Output contract for the code-review skill. Emitted as YAML. Use | block scalars for multi-line values.

scope.description: What was reviewed — file path, PR, commit, or diff description.

verdict.description: Merge verdict derived from findings. Omit on a Failed result.

impact.description: One-sentence impact statement. Omit on a No Issues result.

actions.description: Terse list of review actions taken.

findings.description: Defects found, sorted by severity: Critical → High → Medium → Low → Nit.

severity.description: Severity ranked by user impact or exploitability.

excerpt.description: Quoted code excerpt supporting the finding.

trigger.description: Concrete trigger scenario: input or state, reachable code path, and material impact.

suppressed_findings.description: Findings carrying qualifying intent evidence or lacking a concrete trigger scenario, moved out of findings for audit; never shift result or verdict. Omit this key entirely when empty.

severity.description: Severity ranked by user impact or exploitability.

excerpt.description: Quoted code excerpt supporting the finding.

trigger.description: Concrete trigger scenario, when one exists; omit for a finding suppressed for lacking one.

suppressionRationale.description: Quoted intent evidence and its source (commit, PR description, comment, or requester statement), or the missing trigger scenario, justifying suppression.
